hero.origin: Original parametric open-band linework. Relative SVG commands preserve all 6,510 original plotted vertices with smaller markup. The website restores its original 1.3-second subtle rotation/fade entrance, followed by a still illustration, with a reduced-motion fallback. No external image or photograph.
hero.reason: The optical-band structure connects many strands into a readable whole without inventing product data or a fake app screenshot.

social.origin: Original static composition using the hero geometry and actual Manrope glyph outlines, rasterized with Sharp. Provenance is embedded as XMP in the output PNG.

icons.selection: Build-time extraction; no icon runtime or third-party CDN request

figma: The official Figma resource index and design guidance were checked through a read-only delegate. Library search needed a file key that was not supplied. No Figma file, upload, or guessed library asset was used.
imageGeneration: No image-generation key was configured. The selected direction is exact geometric media, not a simulated photograph; no placeholder imagery is shipped.
